visualReview.notes: Inspected all 11 final portable/source-terrain views. Individually authored warm-stone cathedral has two western square towers with open octagonal round-arched belfries, gray-tinted stone cones, corner pinnacles and finials. A central clock gable and pointed wood portal connect the towers. Tall nave, transverse crossing, clerestory, lower aisle gable rhythm, square eastern flank towers, green crossing turret, polygonal choir, lower ambulatory and five radiating chapels retain the current map plans. Southern cloister ranges surround an empty court with actual post/pointed-arch galleries and sloping roofs; the eastern chapel retains its separate mass. Corrected upper window/buttress alignment, excluded inward tower fields blocked by the central gable, supported the sloping gallery roofs and widened the portal/court review cameras. Peripheral cloister facades and carved ornament remain simplified.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Inspected all 11 final shared-material/geographic views. Five existing 256-square graphs provide raw limestone, slate, copper, granite and plain wood. Warm stone walls, pale trim, gray roofs, subdued green-gray copper and brown wood use linear tints and metric UVs; glazing is a flat blue-gray surface. The stone cones use the limestone graph with a gray tint. Skyline uses graph mean colors. Every graph reads once. Unload disposes model geometry, leaves zero live model geometries and restores ground. Geographic-flat-terrain captures show the signed map alignment; portable terrain captures show coarse ground contact. Ground colors are diagnostic.

mediumFiReview.notes: Inspected all 27 final world-viewer-lighting frames: Economy/High, noon/late, three distances, silhouette, six details, four matched whole-model LODs and four transitions. Matched views include the whole cathedral/cloister and finials. Skyline keeps the individual main masses, open four-post rectangular belfries, coarse cones, simplified aisle slopes and flat-roofed cloister ranges. Two small overlapping peripheral masses and portal pinnacles are omitted; gallery floors follow terrain. Its 6.5m error allowance reflects the roughly 6m aisle-roof silhouette change. District adds shared textures, flat facade fields, octagonal round arches, aisle gables, clock and pointed court arcades. Street opens major window/door recesses and adds mullions/pinnacles; closeup/master refine curve facets, frames and abstract crockets. Curvature, openings, roofs and ornament change visibly. Swedish-cottage neighbors are synthetic context, not local mapped buildings.
